overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structural MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histopathology. The T2-FLAIR mismatch strongly supports an IDH-mutant, non-codeleted astrocytoma, while the substantial necrotic/non-enhancing core, enhancement, edema, mass effect, ependymal invasion, and satellites favor high-grade behavior. Molecular testing remains required for definitive WHO CNS5 classification, especially because imaging cannot assess CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion.
